Why Choose Casto's

Casto's Auto Repair is a faith-based automotive repair shop on US-23 in Chillicothe — driven by faith, fueled by service. Owner Devin Casto and the team treat every customer like family. No job too big or small.

We specialize in engine repair and diagnostics, along with maintenance, brakes, tires, and the everyday fixes that keep Ross County on the road. No unnecessary upsells — just quality parts and straightforward service.

Financing is available to help you get the repairs you need. Ask us about options when you call or stop in.

Serving Chillicothe, Ross County, and surrounding areas with integrity.

Essential Care

Keep your website secure, fast, and professional with simple, reliable maintenance.

Who This Is For

Essential Care is designed for small businesses that want their new website to stay secure and functional without needing regular updates or strategy work. It’s ideal for:

  • Contractors, mechanics, and service businesses with basic websites
  • Clients who want “set it and forget it” peace of mind
  • Businesses that don’t need ongoing content changes or marketing support

What’s Included

Core Maintenance

  • Monthly security monitoring and malware scans
  • Reliable automatic backups
  • Regular core platform and security updates
  • Uptime monitoring with alerts if something goes wrong

Support & Updates

  • Up to 60 minutes of small text or content changes per quarter (price updates, phone number changes, minor service description tweaks, etc.)
  • Email support with a 48-hour response target

Quarterly Check-In

  • One simple quarterly status email summarizing your site’s health and performance

What’s Not Included

  • Major website updates or new pages
  • Regular content creation or blog posts
  • Google Business Profile management
  • Local SEO work or reporting
  • Strategy calls or proactive recommendations
  • Priority or phone support

$59 – $99 per month

This tier is priced to be accessible for small local businesses while still providing professional-level security and maintenance.

Growth Partner

A practical monthly partnership that keeps your website actively working to bring in more business.

Who This Is For

Growth Partner is designed for established small businesses that want their website to do more than just exist. It’s ideal for:

  • Businesses ready to generate more leads and customers from their website
  • Clients who want regular updates, Google Business Profile management, and local SEO attention
  • Companies that value a consistent, proactive partner rather than reactive support

What’s Included

Everything in Essential Care, Plus:

  • Up to 3 hours of updates per month — content refreshes, new sections, service page improvements, and small website enhancements
  • Google Business Profile management — including photos, posts, optimization, and profile health
  • Monthly local SEO monitoring — tracking how you’re performing in local search + simple competitor insights
  • Quarterly 30-minute strategy calls — review progress and plan the next 90 days
  • Two major updates per year — included beyond your monthly hours (examples: new service page, significant content overhaul, layout improvements)
  • Quarterly performance reports — website traffic, leads, and key metrics

Which Plan Is Right For You?

Not sure which ongoing support plan fits your business? Answer these quick questions to find the best fit.

1. How involved do you want to be with your website?

A. I want it to stay secure and professional with minimal effort.
→ Essential Care is the best fit.

B. I want regular updates and help generating more leads locally.
→ Growth Partner is likely the right choice.

C. I want a true strategic partner who’s deeply involved in my online growth.
→ Signature Alliance is designed for you.
2. How important is Google Business Profile and local visibility to your business?

A. Not a priority right now.
→ Essential Care

B. Important — I want consistent management and monitoring.
→ Growth Partner

C. Very important — I want proactive strategy and full execution.
→ Signature Alliance
3. How much communication and strategy support do you want?

A. Just occasional updates via email.
→ Essential Care

B. Quarterly check-ins and planning.
→ Growth Partner

C. Monthly strategy calls and direct access when needed.
→ Signature Alliance

Quick Summary

Essential Care — Simple, affordable maintenance. Perfect if you just want your site to stay secure and up-to-date with very little involvement.

Growth Partner — The sweet spot for most established businesses. Regular updates, Google Business Profile management, local SEO monitoring, and quarterly strategy.

Signature Alliance — Premium white-glove service. Maximum hours, direct access, monthly strategy, and long-term planning. For businesses that want a true ongoing digital partner.
